title: Explicit homology terms and filtration maps
statement: Let $C$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $K$ a cochain complex, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Put $D^{P,Q}=H^{P+Q}(F^{-Q}K)$ and $E^{P,Q}=H^{P+Q}(\operatorname{gr}^{-Q}K)$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. The map $\alpha:D^{P,Q}\to D^{P-1,Q+1}$ is homology of the inclusion $F^{-Q}K\to F^{-(Q+1)}K$. The map $g:D^{P,Q}\to E^{P,Q}$ is homology of the graded projection. The map $f:E^{P,Q}\to D^{P+2,Q-1}$ is the connecting homomorphism of $0\to F^{-Q+1}K\to F^{-Q}K\to\operatorname{gr}^{-Q}K\to0$. This sequence is short exact because the inclusion is mono and the projection is its cokernel. The targets are identified by the integer equalities $P-1+(Q+1)=P+Q$, $-(Q-1)=-Q+1$ and $P+2+(Q-1)=P+Q+1$. In the Lean map $g$, its target is expressed as $(P+0,Q-0)$, with the equality transport. These are explicit homology maps and connecting morphisms, not data selected from an existence assertion.
